instruction.text: Drag and match the information to the correct drink.

a.sound: Water is the healthiest drink. It should be the drink you have the most of.
Tea is hot water with herbs. It is healthy but can contain caffeine, so you shouldn’t drink too much. Some herbal teas are even helpful when you are feeling ill.
Milk can be good for growing bones, but you shouldn’t have too much of it.

instruction.text: Drag and match the information to the correct drink.

a.sound: Juice contains vitamins but also lots of sugar, so it shouldn’t be drunk too often.
Fizzy drinks are not healthy because they contain a lot of sugar. However, it can be a nice treat every once in a while.
Coffee is hot water with ground coffee beans. It contains caffeine, which can boost energy, but should not be drunk by children.
